svg.aria-label: High level architecture of cash-payments-dashboard. Sources: Client CSV files (olist_orders_dataset.csv, olist_order_payments_dataset.csv, olist_customers_dataset.csv, payment_methods.csv, regions.csv). Data warehouse on PostgreSQL, 5 layers left to right. Bronze Layer: Schema bronze; Object Type Tables (6); Load Batch, full reload, Drop & create, Text, as in the file; Transformations None (as-is), Lineage columns, Bad rows to quarantine; Built by load.py. Silver Layer: Schema silver; Object Type Tables (5); Load Batch, full rebuild, Drop & create; Transformations Types set, Primary keys, No rule, no rename; Built by 2_silver.sql. Gold Layer: Schema gold; Object Type Tables (1); Load Batch, full rebuild, Drop & create; Transformations One row per instalment, Cash date, amount, Status, late flag; Built by 3_gold.sql. Semantic Layer: Schema semantic; Object Type Tables (4); Load Batch, full rebuild, Drop & create; Data Model Star schema, 1 fact, 3 dimensions, Keys enforced; Built by 4_semantic.sql. Analytical Layer: Schema analytical; Object Type Views (3); Load None (views); Transformations Totals by method, By region, by month; Built by 5_analytical.sql. Consume: Power BI Report, powerbi/, reads 4 semantic tables, pages Daily cash, Due and late. Consume: Analysis notebook, analysis/analysis.ipynb, reads 6 tables and views. Python orchestrates and runs the pipeline: load.py checks the input files, loads Bronze, runs the four SQL files in order and checks that every payment and every cent is in the model; one transaction.
svg.title: cash-payments-dashboard high level architecture

g.text: Python orchestrates and runs the pipeline
load.py checks the input files, loads Bronze, runs the four SQL files in order and checks that every payment and every cent is in the model; one transaction.
